claimBoundary: The algebra, quotient representatives, and covariant transformation law are mathematically grounded. The coefficient probe, temporal layout, and conversion of exact within-orbit value rank to MIDI pitch are authored sonification choices. Receiver invariance for order-zero generators is exact at the symbolic MIDI-control level, not a guarantee about any external synthesizer, room, listener, or physical interpretation.
